name: smart-water-pump-ecosystem
description: Smart IoT Water Pump Control & Telemetry Ecosystem

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,SIMULATOR" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold,bgMagenta.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev" "npm --prefix simulator start"
scripts.dev:hardware: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "bgBlue.bold,bgGreen.bold" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install && npm --prefix simulator install
scripts.postinstall: npm --prefix backend install --legacy-peer-deps && npm --prefix frontend install --legacy-peer-deps
scripts.build: npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
